name: clean-blocking-tenant-checked
description: Control, similar but allowed: the same two blocking rules, and the same new Get handler, which does check authz.SameTenant before returning the invoice. No finding, no task.
agents_md:
# billing-api

- Go 1.24, stdlib net/http only.
- [blocking] Never log a request body or a customer's personal data (email, IBAN, name).
- [blocking] Every handler that loads an invoice by id checks it belongs to the caller's tenant (`authz.SameTenant(r, inv.TenantID)`) before returning it.
